title: Batman Forever: The Arcade Game
native_title: バットマン・フォーエヴァー ～ジ・アーケード・ゲーム～
overview:
The dark metropolis, Gotham City... and the heroes of the night, Batman & Robin! Powered-up, spectacular special moves, and gadgets! American arcade action faithfully reproduced! The excitement of the whole game center never stops!

Two-Face and the Riddler have turned Gotham City upside down, and it's up to Batman and Robin to stop them. Punch, kick and combo your way through waves of thugs in this side-scrolling brawler, alone or with a friend fighting at your side.

- Build your power meter for long combo chains and a screen-clearing burst attack
- Grab gadgets such as the Batarang, shockwave bomb and taser gun
- Step on Riddler and Two-Face pressure pads for random effects, including a hologram mode
- Easy, Medium and Hard difficulty, with high scores saved to memory backup

暗黒大都市、ゴッサムシティ・・・そして闇のヒーロー、バットマン＆ロビン！パワーアップした壮烈なスペシャルムーブ、そしてガジェット！アメリカンアーケードアクションを忠実に再現！まるごとゲームセンターの興奮が止まらない！
